evals.name: scaffold-gift-cards-admin
evals.prompt: Scaffold a new /dashboard/gift-cards admin page with a server-paginated table like categories — domain folder, columns, route page, loading and error.tsx.
evals.expected_output: src/domains/gift-cards/ with domain file and columns, thin page.tsx under app/(admin)/dashboard/gift-cards/, useServerTable + Table.*, no data in Zustand.
assertions: Output creates src/domains/<name>/ structure not src/features/
Output uses useServerTable and Table from @/components/table/data-table
Output creates thin page.tsx that delegates to a domain component
Output mentions loading.tsx and error.tsx for the route segment
Output does not put server list data in Zustand

evals.name: admin-nav-gotcha
evals.prompt: I added the gift cards dashboard route but it does not show in the admin sidebar.
evals.expected_output: Agent explains backend-driven nav via /user-menu-structure or menu seed — not a frontend-only fix.
assertions: Response mentions admin nav is backend-driven
Response references menu config or user-menu-structure rather than only editing frontend sidebar code
